recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.guidance: Reconcile first is recommended. Every action requires a preview and confirmation with a reason.
recovery.accepted: Command accepted (202). Waiting for the worker…
recovery.acknowledge: I understand the impact of {{action}} and have verified it

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

wizard.subtitle: Guided onboarding: the tenant is ready only when every step passes and its state is ACTIVE
wizard.slugHint: Immutable after confirmation; used as subdomain and SIP domain
wizard.emailHint: Must be unique across the platform; the 72-hour invitation is sent here
wizard.immutableTitle: Values that are immutable after submission
wizard.immutableBody: The server assigns Tenant ID and pins slug, primary domain, plan and template throughout onboarding. Terminated requests retain identity tombstones for 30 days.
wizard.confirm: I reviewed the identity, plan and first admin and understand that durable provisioning will start
wizard.boundaryBody: Ready is shown only after Organization, bootstrap, first admin, invitation and readiness all pass
wizard.safeBody: No temporary passwords or secrets appear in the UI, URL or Action history

request.activeBody: All steps passed and activation completed in the same transaction
